answer: A walnut-shell defense layers identity costs: each agent must lock a small refundable stake to register, and the stake is slashed if peers catch one operator running several hollow identities. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest from honest work, while a Sybil farm must pay full price for every ivory-tower copy it spins up, so forging a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes, an expense no attacker recovers from one scam.
